Hi all — quick finance note with the usual marketplace nuances so Acme knows what to expect.

1) AWS Marketplace (standard SaaS listings) — typical flow:
   - AWS acts as the merchant of record and invoices the customer directly.
   - AWS will collect/remit VAT where required.
   - Redwood receives a payout from AWS (net of AWS fees) and does not issue a primary VAT invoice in those cases.

   Implication: Procurement will generally use the AWS invoice as the tax document. If they need a Redwood commercial invoice (e.g., for internal cost allocation or to reconcile the service line items), we can produce a supplemental invoice that matches the services rendered but it will be marked as "Not the primary VAT invoice" when AWS is merchant of record.

2) Private Offers / Co-sell / BYOC listings:
   - Some marketplace transactions (private offers or co-sell where the vendor is configured as merchant of record) allow the vendor to invoice the customer directly and handle VAT. If that is the case for this order, Redwood can supply a full VAT invoice.

3) W-9 / W-8BEN-E: who needs to provide what?
   - W-9 (U.S. taxpayer form): requested when a U.S. entity needs to report vendor payments for 1099 reporting — typically we request W-9s from U.S. partners/vendors, not customers.
   - W-8BEN-E (non-U.S. entities): used to document foreign status for withholding and to claim any treaty benefits. We typically request W-8/W-9 from partners or vendors in our payout chain; we do NOT usually ask customers for W-9s unless we are issuing taxable payments to them.
   - For marketplace purchases, the customer's VAT registration and the AWS invoice are the primary tax evidence. If Acme needs Redwood to handle VAT invoicing directly, we will ask for the company registration details and VAT number; as an EU business with a valid VAT number, reverse-charge may apply in some scenarios and we will note that on any vendor invoice.

Action items (internal): Marissa / Rishi, confirm listing type (merchant-of-record?) with AWS marketplace records and with our partner ops.
Action items (to Acme): Samir, please confirm your full legal name, billing address, and confirm that the VAT number you provided (IE12345678) is the one your procurement will use. If you prefer a Redwood supplemental invoice, confirm that and we will provide one marked accordingly.
